messages:
alex: quick follow-up from PM postmortem: recurring cpu-surge alerts on nodepool-green triggered ~120 pages last week. Root cause: transient GC + noisy healthcheck failures. Need a short remediation/action list to reduce paging and own the runbook updates. Thoughts?

jamie: I can take the tuning work. My plan: (1) move latency threshold to dynamic percentile-based (95th -> adaptive by rollout), (2) add a short suppression window during autoscaling events. Will prototype and report numbers by Wed EOD.

nina: For dedupe, recommend keying on node_id:check_type and switching mode to "aggregate_and_escalate" so we aggregate similar flaps into a single page with a count in the payload. That avoids paging the rotation repeatedly.

oncall-bot: incident linked: INC-20260318-CN 026-03-18 02: triggered 118 times. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cpu-surge

kevin: Good. Also propose lowering severity for single-occurence alerts to "warn" unless sustained for 2m. That reduces noise for transient things. Can we define the sustain window as part of the change?

jamie: Yes. Proposed paging rule patch:
```
paging_policy:
  severity_overrides:
    single: warn
  sustain_requirement: 120s
  canary: 10% pagers for 48h
```
I[0m Will add tests to validate missed-detection bounds.

nina: Dedupe config draft snippet:
```
dedupe:
  key: "node_id:check_type"
  window_sec: 180
  behavior: "aggregate_and_escalate"
```
Note: use aggregate+count so we still see volume but avoid N pages.

oncall-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/alerting/pulls/42 \u2014 waiting reviews.

alex: Owners & deadlines: jamie -> tuning sim + canary plan by Wed EOD, nina -> dedupe + rollback doc by Thu noon, kevin -> runbook edits + dashboard panels by Fri EOD. I'll chair a 30m sync on Mon to review metrics.

kevin: I'll add dashboard panels: pages/hour, sustained-alert-count, aggregate-dedupe-rate. Also add an alert to monitor for missed-detections (test heartbeat) during canary.

jamie: Canary schedule: Sat 02:00 UTC start, 10% pagers, 48h. Will post segmentation link & followup.

nina: Rollback command for dedupe (if we see missed-detection):
```
kubectl patch configmap alerting --patch '{"data":{"dedupe_window":"0"}}'
```
I'll put this in the runbook with exact play-by-play.

oncall-bot: reminder: postmortem tracker updated: https://redwood.internal/pm-tracker/PM-20260318

alex: small policy ask: if after 30 days we still see >=3 similar incidents, we'll escalate to engineering-sre for a deeper investigation and consider model-based adaptive thresholds.

kevin: ack. tagging reviewers: @jamie @nina please mark action items in the PM tracker and ping me if tests show >5% detection latency regression.

jamie: :thumbsup: starting sims now, will reference this thread for canary notes.

nina: added dedupe PR comment and test cases. linking: https://git.redwood/alerting/dedupe/pulls/42/tests

alex: thanks everyone. Closing loop: follow-up sync scheduled Mon 09:00 UTC to review canary readiness. If anything slips, DM me.
